name: MusicBrainz
author: Viboplr
description: Artist and album images from MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive

assistant.instructions: Artist images (MusicBrainz relations/Wikimedia) and album covers (Cover Art Archive). Fetch one via POST /v1/images/{artist|album} with pluginId=musicbrainz (returns the url inline). Slow by design — MusicBrainz rate-limiting adds ~1-2s per lookup; prefer deezer/itunes for speed and this for coverage of obscure releases.
